WOW The food here is amazing
Oct 2023 • Friends
If you're craving authentic Japanese cuisine, SUSHI HOKKAIDO is perhaps the best choice. They offer incredibly fresh sushi and sashimi. It must be emphasized that it is very, very fresh. It deserves 100 points
The Wagyu beef is of excellent quality, perfectly balancing meat and fat, melting in your mouth. I enjoy having it with salad or a bit of rice, wow I'm in heaven. The rice here is slightly different from other Japanese restaurants in Vietnam, the flexible, soft, aromatic rice, making it an excellent accompaniment, especially with unagi. I finished the meal with "chakochee white chocolate," a delightful dessert that I almost couldn't bring myself to eat because it's as cute as cheese in Tom & Jerry.

Great food, combined with the friendly and attentive staff, made this a wonderful experience for us. It's definitely worth a try. 
One tip when dining here: it can get quite crowded, so make a reservation in advance to avoid long waits.

Paradise revisted
Mar 2020
We had been Vietnam for three weeks and when got into Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) we decided to take our niece and her boyfriend out for a special dinner. Neither one had really ever experienced sushi so we went to Hokkaido Sushi in District 7 where they live. Ok..so let's cut to the chase...it was incredible. The rice was perfect, the fish was fresh and gorgeous, the service was excellent, the beef was flowing ( I had their peach tea..beautiful) and at the end of it all the final tab was fantastic. If you were to have the amount of food we had you would have spent nearly 300 euros for this dinner. Here we spent about 70 euros equivalent and it was worth every penny. Everyone came away delighted at the experience and the quality of the food. 

This is definite stop on the dinner tour. You can sit in or outside. We sat out and had one of the best evenings, ever. Perfect temperature, excellent atmosphere and got to hang with my niece and her boyfriend. In short, a perfect evening! 

Located in District (Quan) 7 at the Crescent Mall it is worth the cab ride if you are not staying in this district and an easy enough cab ride if you are staying out in District 7. 

Bon Appetit!

New Sushi Hokkaido Sachi Outlet
Oct 2018 • Friends
Sushi Hokkaido Sachi is always on my/our restaurant to visit everytime we come to HCMC. I have visited all the 5 outlets in HCMC.
However this visit to the new outlet at Pasteur Street was a slight disappointment. 
We made reservation for a private room for 3 people 3 days ahead was not reserve for us. 
We brought along our own whiskey .. (like the other outlets it was ok corkage charges apply). Here the staff were unsure what to charge us although it was listed in the menu. 
Service levels was not as good as the other outlets.
The new restaurant look nice layout wise not crammed like Dong Du.
Food wise .. the standard is being maintained like the other Hokkaido Sachi outlets.
One thing I would like to highlight is the foods or dishes should be serve not all at once .. progressively, should be paced out especially where there is hot foods.
Sushi Hokkaido Sachi is still one of our favourite restaurants in HCMC.
